title: Best Betting Exchange App (2026)
verdict: The best betting exchange app in 2026 depends on what you mean by app. If you mean the thing on your phone from one exchange, Novig and ProphetX have the cleanest US apps and Betfair has the most complete one outside the US. If you mean the product that gets you the best exchange price, that is TerminalUp, a web terminal that prices every connected exchange together and routes the order from one account.

TerminalUp is built for a screen, not a thumb. It runs in the browser, needs no app store download, and is the right tool when the trade is big enough that the price matters more than the convenience.

why: An exchange app shows you its own book. A terminal shows you every book. On TerminalUp each side of a market carries the best fee-adjusted price across the connected exchanges, prediction markets and sportsbooks, with the size available at that price. The order ticket routes the stake to the best venue and splits it when one cannot fill it.

That also means one login instead of five. You fund one TerminalUp account. Orders route to venues from it. Nineteen venues are live, sixteen more are in the pipeline, and none of them needs its own app on your phone.

TerminalUp charges Commission is 0.5% per trade, 0.35% at the highest volume, no subscription. It never takes the other side of a trade, so the price on the screen is the best one it can find, not the one that pays it most.
